notes: New free trial: one car for 24 hours, counted from when you connect the car. Home and About show the hours left, and the trial is offered again after 31 October. Beta updates are now part of the lifetime licence. Keys tab: a number too big for the setting now says so (for example "300 does not fit: 1 byte holds 0 to 255"). More error messages say in plain words what went wrong.
